text_block_list.text: (Swish... swish... swish...)
(Swish... swish... swish...)
(Swish... swish... swish...)
(Swish—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Done.

Today is Christmas. Tracen Academy, too,
is wrapped in a festive and cheerful atmosphere.
However, as for ourselves—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Let's do our best again today.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's start with a warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood.
I'm heading out.

I start training as usual.
Many teams have the day off today, so the grounds are deserted, but—

Even when I suggested taking a break and making some fun plans,
Believe firmly replied, "No, thank you."

"In that case, it wouldn't be right to force 'having fun' on anyone either.
So with that in mind..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew-w-w...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...With the temperature this low, it seems harder for our bodies to warm up."
choice_data_list: Let's try to be a bit more careful. Now, for some extra—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: The dirt track... is quite dry, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's going to kick up quite a lot of dust,
so please watch your eyes.
choice_data_list: You too, Believe. Alright, let's start!
You too, Believe. Okay, let's start!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... phew.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...That concludes your order, correct?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Great work, Believe!
Yeah. Good work, Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Thank you very much.

"Having finished the scheduled menu, Believe gave a small bow
and headed toward her belongings."
choice_data_list: (Maybe she needs to hydrate?)

text_block_list.text:
"Once she comes back, we should discuss tomorrow's schedule."
...Just as I was thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

I involuntarily stare in blank amazement.
...A magatama. ...It looks familiar.
That looks familiar—ah, right, I remember now.

Over two years ago. Around the summer of her Junior year,
I often saw her holding it—
choice_data_list: Um... is that the magatama you've been polishing all this time...?
Um... that magatama you've been polishing all this time...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...It took quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I just couldn't bring myself to be satisfied with my condition.
Not at all...—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Like... shaping it more neatly,
or softening the curves, and things like that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want it to feel comfortable in my hands, and...
There are so many details I'm particular about.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It ended up taking...
...quite a long time."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've finally reached a quality
worthy of being handed over.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Here you are.
...If it wouldn't be a bother, that is.

Still in a daze, I accept it.
The blue jade magatama fits into my hand
with astonishing, seamless ease.

The moment the sincerity hidden in the texture touched my heart,
I couldn't help myself—and blurted out the question.
choice_data_list: All this time... Why me, for all this time?
All this time... Why me, for all this time?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Magatama hold the power to ward off evil.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So... it's just a small prayer, for things
like health and vitality, but still...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to give it to you.
...What about you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Because they're someone who is working with me.
choice_data_list: Believe...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: …………Um, that is all for the reasoning.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm? Ah.
Come to think of it, today just happens to—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas.

Still, I can't just stand here being touched by the gift!
Today really is Christmas, after all.

Asking to at least give something in return,
I came to the Christmas market with her.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(That said...
there isn't really anything I need right now...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ah. ...There are leather goods stalls set up.
choice_data_list: You're right, there's all kinds of stuff here... Hm?
You're right, there's all kinds of stuff here, huh... Hm?

text_block_list.text:
Just then, a braided leather cord caught my eye.
This... would look so good with the magatama Believe gave me earlier!
choice_data_list: (Alright, let's try this—)

text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to buy it, I suddenly noticed something.
Right beside it was—
There was also a DIY kit complete with instructions and ingredients for sale.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Aren't you going to buy the leather cord?
choice_data_list: ...No! I'll go with this one!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You want to make it by hand...?
Have you ever done leatherworking before?
choice_data_list: No, not at all. This'll be a first for us, huh?

text_block_list.text:
"Even so—" I murmur, savoring the soft sensation
that still lingers in my hand.

"Even so, if you truly want to find something
worthy of being that one precious piece..."
choice_data_list: I want to put in the effort and make it just right.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: Wait, sorry! And here I went to buy some for you!
Wait, sorry! And here I went to buy some for you!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Does that handmade craft kit
only make a single leather cord?
choice_data_list: Huh? No, it looks like we can make about five of them, though.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Then please give me just one of them.
choice_data_list: ...It might take an awful lot of time, you know?!
...It might take an awful lot of time, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
Even so, please give it to me."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —I'll be waiting for you.
